items.headline: Stocks surge Monday: S&P 500 up 4.7%, Nasdaq up 6.5%, Dow up 3%
items.note: The S&P 500 closed at 7,237.17, the Nasdaq at 24,089.56 and the Dow at 49,595.31, ending the S&P's seven-session losing streak. The jump recovered a bit more than half of the prior week's 8.6% S&P drop, and Nvidia's CEO news drove it.

items.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; stock jumps more than 31%
items.note: The board voted to bring Huang back effective immediately, 11 days after he resigned, citing input from senior U.S. government levels. Nvidia closed around $165.05, which lifted AMD, Micron and Dell too.

items.headline: Trump says he 'convinced' Nvidia's board to rehire Huang
items.note: CNBC reports the board's decision came after a personal assurance from Trump on Sunday. The board had publicly refused to rehire Huang four days earlier, and lawmakers from both parties reacted with shock. Senator Warren said Huang and the board still owe Congress answers.

items.headline: Anthropic (ANT) slips about 1.4% on its third day of trading
items.note: The stock fell 9.1% Friday and has been choppy since its Nov. 19 debut at an $83 IPO price. It is a good example of how new AI-linked stocks swing with the whole sector.

items.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at about $43.9 billion
items.note: Each Zscaler share converts into 1.135 CrowdStrike shares, a roughly 34% premium. Zscaler rose about 13% and CrowdStrike fell about 9% on the news. This is a big cybersecurity consolidation, and the deal is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028.

items.headline: Nvidia's last report: revenue up 103% and a higher forecast
items.note: Fiscal Q3 revenue rose 103% to $116 billion, and Nvidia guided to $130 billion next quarter. Even so, the stock was down about 39% over the past month before Monday's jump, so doubts about AI spending returns are still the main worry.

items.headline: 10-year yield near 4.92%, oil lower; PCE inflation due Wednesday
items.note: The VIX fear gauge fell about 26% to 26.62. The PCE inflation report on Wednesday will shape Fed rate expectations. Markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving and shut at 1 p.m. Friday.

items.headline: Tech hiring is recovering but still below pre-pandemic levels, one market report says
items.note: The same report found statistics and ML skills in 92% of early-2026 data science postings. Layoff trackers still show heavy cuts this year, and some are tied to AI. Keep ML and stats fundamentals front and center.

learn.term: All-stock acquisition and the deal premium
learn.explain: When one company buys another, it can pay in cash, in its own shares, or both. In an all-stock deal, each target share is swapped for a fixed number of the buyer's shares, called the exchange ratio. CrowdStrike offered 1.135 of its shares for each Zscaler share. At CrowdStrike's Nov. 20 price, that was worth about $260.41, or a premium of about 34% over Zscaler's price. Buyers pay a premium to persuade owners to sell. Because the payment is in shares, the deal's dollar value moves with the buyer's stock price, and that is why Zscaler's stock follows CrowdStrike's until the deal closes.
learn.try: Look up the Zscaler and CrowdStrike prices today and multiply CrowdStrike's price by 1.135. How close is the result to Zscaler's price?
